name: The Wide Woman (Anne Lepelaars)
reason: Re-checked under the 12 Nov rule (thewidewoman.com, 12 Nov 2026): wellbeing and trauma-healing wording is no longer a bar, but the site presents Anne Lepelaars as a somatic mental health therapist, somatic trauma psychologist and 'pleasure and capacity coach' who supports humanitarian workers; her offers are 1:1 coaching and therapy and online somatic programmes on emotions, nervous-system capacity and women's embodiment (RANGE, Slow & Deep, Getting Wider, Say Yes to Your Mess). Her guided meditations sit on Insight Timer and Soundcloud, not her own site. This is mainly therapy and somatic coaching rather than spiritual or contemplative teaching, so she stays out of scope. Borderline: Getting Wider is framed as a 'holy, messy, mystical' 40-day practice, so the owner may disagree.
